title: DataObject schema metadata naming roles
description: DataObject schema metadata naming roles Each enum constant denotes a configuration key, not the literal generated field or method name.

oneOf.title: Source schema URL field
oneOf.description: Field in the source schema definition carrying its canonical URL (normally $id). An empty configured mapping disables this extraction.

oneOf.title: Source schema identifier field
oneOf.description: Field in the source schema definition carrying its stable logical identifier, for example x-algites-schema-id. An empty configured mapping disables this extraction.

oneOf.title: Source schema version field
oneOf.description: Field in the source schema definition carrying the schema version, for example x-algites-schema-version. An empty configured mapping disables this extraction.

oneOf.title: Instance schema URL field
oneOf.description: Field in a serialized DataObject instance carrying the canonical schema URL (normally $schema). Omitted or empty mapping disables reading and emitting this field; requires source URL mapping when enabled.

oneOf.title: Instance schema identifier field
oneOf.description: Field in a serialized DataObject instance carrying the logical schema identifier. Omitted or empty mapping disables reading and emitting this field; requires source identifier mapping when enabled.

oneOf.title: Instance schema version field
oneOf.description: Field in a serialized DataObject instance carrying the logical schema version. Omitted or empty mapping disables reading and emitting this field; requires source version mapping when enabled.
